status_rule: controlled=True requires: controller actually started, destination actually assigned, both actors alive, ownership registered, position governed
defect_found: build_controlled_walker returned controlled=True and controller_started=True even when start() or the destination assignment had failed, and left a live walker behind on controller failure.
validator_hardening: validate_walker_mode rejects an entry claiming traffic while uncontrolled, and counts a controlled walker only when neither controller_started nor destination_assigned is explicitly False (an absent key stays tolerated for legacy callers)
structural_guard: test_status_is_never_true_without_a_real_controller parses the AST and asserts controlled=True appears exactly once, on the committed-success path only
